_comment: Wrap the overworld's final_density with caero_karos_terrain:final_density_seed_themed. The wrap inserts caero_rings:select_by_seed_theme at the root of the noise router's final_density chain; inside themed Voronoi cells the dispatcher hands off to nether_pit_final / end_floating_final, everywhere else it passes through to the original final_density (the lithostitched:wrapped_marker placeholder resolves to whatever the previous final_density was — Tectonic's wrap if Tectonic is loaded, otherwise vanilla overworld).
